info.name: Campaign Service API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Campaign Management Microservice.

Base URL: http://localhost:3004

All endpoints under /api/campaigns require a valid JWT Bearer token in the Authorization header.

## Authentication
Obtain a JWT token from the User Service and set it in the `token` collection variable.

## Campaign Statuses
- `draft` – Initial state
- `scheduled` – Scheduled for future execution
- `running` – Currently sending messages
- `paused` – Temporarily paused
- `completed` – All messages sent
- `failed` – Execution failed
- `cancelled` – Manually cancelled

request.description: Check if the Campaign Service is running. No authentication required.

item.name: CRUD Operations

request.description:
Create a new campaign.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` (string) – Campaign name

**Optional Fields:**
- `description` (string) – Campaign description
- `templateId` (string) – WhatsApp template ID
- `groupId` (integer) – Contact group ID
- `scheduledAt` (ISO 8601 datetime) – When to schedule the campaign
- `status` (string) – Initial status (default: `draft`)
- `metadata` (object) – Additional metadata including:
  - `wabaId` – WhatsApp Business Account ID
  - `phoneNumberId` – Phone number ID for sending
  - `bodyParameters` – Template body parameter values
  - `components` – WhatsApp API component parameters

The service will automatically fetch the template name and group name from the Template Service and Contact Service respectively.

request.description:
Update an existing campaign. Send only the fields you want to update.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` (string)
- `description` (string)
- `template_id` (string)
- `group_id` (integer)
- `scheduled_at` (ISO 8601 datetime)
- `status` (string)
- `metadata` (JSON string)
- Any other column in the campaigns table

Cache is invalidated on update.

item.name: Campaign Execution

request.description:
Start executing a campaign. This will:

1. Validate campaign exists and is not already running/completed
2. Fetch template details from Template Service
3. Fetch group contacts from Contact Service
4. Retrieve WABA account and phone number from User Service
5. Create campaign logs for each recipient
6. Publish `campaign_started` event to Kafka
7. Update campaign status to `running`

**Prerequisites:**
- Campaign must be in `draft`, `scheduled`, `paused`, or `failed` status
- Template must exist and be valid
- Group must have at least one contact
- User must have a connected WhatsApp Business Account with a phone number

**Kafka Event:** `campaign.events` topic with `campaign_started` event

response.name: 400 - No Contacts
400 - No WABA

request.description:
Pause a currently running campaign.

**Prerequisite:** Campaign must be in `running` status.

**Kafka Event:** `campaign.events` topic with `campaign_paused` event

Resume a paused campaign.

**Prerequisite:** Campaign must be in `paused` status.

**Kafka Event:** `campaign.events` topic with `campaign_resumed` event

Cancel a campaign.

**Prerequisite:** Campaign must be in `running`, `paused`, or `scheduled` status.

**Kafka Event:** `campaign.events` topic with `campaign_cancelled` event

Schedule a campaign for future execution.

**Required Fields:**
- `scheduledAt` (ISO 8601 datetime) – Must be a future date/time

**Prerequisite:** Campaign must be in `draft` or `scheduled` status.

Updates campaign status to `scheduled` and sets the `scheduled_at` timestamp.

response.name: 400 - Past Date
400 - Invalid Status

item.name: Analytics & Reporting

request.description:
Get aggregate analytics for a campaign including delivery rates, read rates, and failure rates.

Analytics are computed from both the `campaigns` table counters and the `campaign_logs` table.

Results are cached for 1 minute.
Alias for the analytics endpoint. Returns the same data as GET /api/campaigns/:id/analytics.

- `limit` (optional, default: 50) – Items per page
